title: Repeated sequence samples with no output can exhaust CPU
ai_system: Anthropic OSS Scanner (model not specified for this finding)
summary: An image sequence can repeatedly decode samples that produce no output, making one track-decode call run for minutes, including when ignore_sequence_editlist is enabled.
ai_role: The item-level libheif advisory explicitly attributes discovery to Anthropic's OSS Scanner as ANT-2026-4HMHRLYL. The release notes independently state that all listed security issues were found by the scanner. The Anthropic program sources establish model-based scanning, but no per-case model is identified.
classification_note: The primary advisory establishes a publicly disclosed security finding and direct Anthropic OSS Scanner attribution. No CVE had been assigned in the libheif release notes at the checked time; the distinct GHSA is used. No exploitation or zero-day status is asserted.
remediation_note: Per-codec limits now bound samples decoded without returning frames; ignore_sequence_editlist stops after original media samples. Fixed in libheif 1.23.7. The libheif v1.23.7 security release is dated 2026-10-26; deployed patch status is not checked.
